task.title: Implement the runnable Echolet CLI
task.description: Make six independent process RED scenarios green by wiring the reviewed command surface to the completed encrypted runtime with stable exits and JSON/redaction contracts.
task.scope: apps/cli command entrypoint, build/bin metadata and minimal public runtime config access

acceptance_criteria: Six process-level T30 tests pass unchanged.
All eight documented command forms are strict, runnable in independent child processes, and use stable 0/2/3/4/5 exits.
Exactly one JSON stdout object is emitted and secrets/plaintext remain redacted outside explicit history.
Real local HTTP publish/send/poll and offline contact/doctor/history paths pass.
Prior CLI/workspace tests and typechecks remain green.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet/.metaproject/index.md before any repository action; load task-implementer and validate paired input.
Confirm process suite RED before editing; do not weaken/delete tests.
Use apply_patch and keryx ctx rg; do not edit apps/relay, flow.json, acceptance-criteria.md, or commit.
Do not print underlying errors, request bodies, keys, seed, private material, ciphertext, or send plaintext; explicit history output may contain authenticated plaintext.
Do not introduce a runtime dependency/build mechanism that fails the stated Node 22.13+ clean-checkout target.
Write and validate the required subagent-result; final first line STATUS:.
